last_etwap_base_supply.meaning: stored exponential TWAP base supply lastETWAPBaseSupply used by _checkMintCap

base_token_supply.meaning: live baseTokenSupply after the first over-threshold mint

no_cap_limit.meaning: noCapLimit exponent such that the cap threshold is 1 << noCapLimit

followup_mint_reverted.meaning: the follow-up mint reverts with E_LEX_MintCapExceeded

assumptions: The first over-threshold mint has already executed, leaving baseTokenSupply above the cap threshold and lastETWAPBaseSupply near zero.
The follow-up mint is a valid mint attempt within the intended cap bound.
noCapLimit is a positive integer exponent; the cap threshold is 1 << noCapLimit.

unresolved.description: The report states the cap threshold as 1 << noCapLimit but gives no plain numeric literal for noCapLimit, so the exact threshold constant cannot be bound; the exponent is kept symbolic and the threshold comparison is expressed at the exponent level.
Exact numeric values of noCapLimit and mintAmount are not given.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the followup_mint_reverts impact; deposits_blocked_hour is not covered by this claim.
The first over-threshold mint is treated as an executed precondition; the report only states it conditionally.
The stale-TWAP root cause is not encoded as a precondition; it is the mechanism behind the revert impact.
The cap threshold is compared at the exponent level (base_token_supply > no_cap_limit) rather than as 1 << noCapLimit, because the report gives no plain numeric literal for the shift.
